fkptjax vs sMGPT cross-check -- I1udd1-family bias/RSD kernels (genuine Q+R+N sum)
====================================================================================

How to use:
1. Go to cloud.wolframcloud.com, sign in (or create a free Wolfram ID).
2. Click "Create New" -> "Notebook".
3. Paste everything below the line of ='s into a single input cell.
4. Press Shift+Enter to evaluate. This does real numerical loop integration
   (Nq*Nx = 160 points, 3 ODE solves each = ~480 solves), so it may take a
   few minutes -- that's expected, just let it run.
5. Copy ALL the printed output (starting from "=== I1udd1-family
   (Q+R+N combined) ===") and paste it back to Claude.

Self-contained -- no external files, no git clone needed. Evaluates sMGPT's
own equations (2_P22type.wl -- A11/A12/A22/A23/A33 "N ordering", tA11/tA12/
tA22/tA23/tA33 "Q ordering", a11/a12/a22/a23/a33 "R ordering", and their
combination KernI1udd1/KernI2uud1/.../KernI3uuu3) directly, all evaluated at
the SAME (r,x) point on the SAME clipped domain and combined before a single
q-integral -- matching sMGPT's own computeOneKBothExact/AKernelsT
architecture -- for the SAME HDKI/BZ_Mass model as the earlier P22/P13
loop-integral snippet (mu_kinf=1.2, lambda_a=lambda_dS=100, Om=0.315192,
z=0.295), at k=0.18205642030260796.

Uses the REAL Abacus linear P(k) (z=0, embedded below), GR-evolved to
z=0.295 (same convention/factor as examples/check_vs_sMGPT_reference.ipynb)
-- NOT a toy analytic spectrum. I've already computed the same 5 quantities
on the fkptjax/Python side (the new genuine three-ordering fix,
fkpt_approximation=False) at this exact k, real P(k), and model -- pasting
your Wolfram output back lets me diff them directly.

====================================================================================

(* ===== fkptjax I1udd1-family cross-check: genuine Q+R+N sum vs sMGPT ===== *)
Needs["NumericalDifferentialEquationAnalysis`"];
om = 0.315192; lambdaA = 100.0; lambdaDS = 100.0; muKinf = 1.2;
z = 0.295; etaini = -6.0; etaev = Log[1./(1. + z)];
kmin = 0.005; kmax = 2.0;
k = 0.18205642030260796;
Nq = 16; Nx = 10; C2 = 3./7.;

  {2.89593476e+00, 2.26136829e+00}, {2.96764591e+00, 2.12805114e+00}, {3.04113281e+00, 2.00243328e+00}, {3.11643945e+00, 1.88408119e+00}, {3.19361089e+00, 1.77258498e+00}, {3.27269330e+00, 1.66755723e+00}, {3.35373400e+00, 1.56863169e+00}, {3.43678149e+00, 1.47546229e+00}, {3.52188545e+00, 1.38772194e+00}, {3.60909682e+00, 1.30510165e+00},
  {3.69846778e+00, 1.22730949e+00}, {3.79005181e+00, 1.15406970e+00}, {3.88390370e+00, 1.08512185e+00}, {3.98007962e+00, 1.02021999e+00}, {4.07863711e+00, 9.59131878e-01}, {4.17963515e+00, 9.01638241e-01}, {4.28313418e+00, 8.47532069e-01}, {4.38919612e+00, 7.96617907e-01}, {4.49788443e+00, 7.48711283e-01}, {4.60926417e+00, 7.03638106e-01},
  {4.72340197e+00, 6.61234134e-01}, {4.84036612e+00, 6.21344411e-01}, {4.96022663e+00, 5.83822763e-01}, {5.08305520e+00, 5.48531315e-01}, {5.20892534e+00, 5.15340030e-01}, {5.33791236e+00, 4.84126280e-01}, {5.47009345e+00, 4.54774407e-01}, {5.60554770e+00, 4.27175350e-01}, {5.74435616e+00, 4.01226297e-01}, {5.88660189e+00, 3.76830340e-01},
  {6.03237001e+00, 3.53896147e-01}, {6.18174774e+00, 3.32337642e-01}, {6.33482446e+00, 3.12073715e-01}, {6.49169178e+00, 2.93027943e-01}, {6.65244356e+00, 2.75128321e-01}, {6.81717598e+00, 2.58307020e-01}, {6.98598762e+00, 2.42500152e-01}, {7.15897949e+00, 2.27647537e-01}, {7.33625511e+00, 2.13692497e-01}, {7.51792055e+00, 2.00581658e-01},
  {7.70408451e+00, 1.88264755e-01}, {7.89485839e+00, 1.76694462e-01}, {8.09035635e+00, 1.65826221e-01}, {8.29069537e+00, 1.55618085e-01}, {8.49599532e+00, 1.46030562e-01}, {8.70637905e+00, 1.37026461e-01}, {8.92197245e+00, 1.28570770e-01}, {9.14290452e+00, 1.20630546e-01}, {9.36930746e+00, 1.13174793e-01}, {9.60131675e+00, 1.06174354e-01},
  {9.83907122e+00, 9.96017955e-02}, {1.00827131e+01, 9.34313141e-02}, {1.03323883e+01, 8.76386392e-02}, {1.05882460e+01, 8.22009421e-02}, {1.08504395e+01, 7.70967679e-02}, {1.11191256e+01, 7.23059586e-02}, {1.13944651e+01, 6.78095520e-02}, {1.16766228e+01, 6.35897137e-02}, {1.19657674e+01, 5.96296701e-02}, {1.22620720e+01, 5.59136474e-02},
  {1.25657140e+01, 5.24268126e-02}, {1.28768749e+01, 4.91552191e-02}, {1.31957410e+01, 4.60857547e-02}, {1.35225031e+01, 4.32060818e-02}, {1.38573567e+01, 4.05045530e-02}, {1.42005022e+01, 3.79702175e-02}, {1.45521449e+01, 3.55927963e-02}, {1.49124952e+01, 3.33626405e-02}, {1.52817687e+01, 3.12706929e-02}, {1.56601865e+01, 2.93084517e-02},
  {1.60479749e+01, 2.74679362e-02}, {1.64453660e+01, 2.57416551e-02}, {1.68525975e+01, 2.41225800e-02}, {1.72699133e+01, 2.26041889e-02}, {1.76975628e+01, 2.11804127e-02}, {1.81358021e+01, 1.98455307e-02}, {1.85848935e+01, 1.85941496e-02}, {1.90451055e+01, 1.74211860e-02}, {1.95167136e+01, 1.63218508e-02}, {2.00000000e+01, 1.52916330e-02}
};
PSL = Interpolation[abacusTable];

mu[eta_, kk_] := Module[{a, Dd, X},
   a = Exp[eta]; Dd = lambdaDS*a^(-3) + lambdaA;
   X = (kk*lambdaA*lambdaDS/(Dd*a))^2; (1 + muKinf*X)/(1 + X)];

f1[eta_] := 2. - 3./(2.(1. + (1. - om)/om Exp[3. eta]));
f2[eta_] := 3./(2.(1. + (1. - om)/om Exp[3. eta]));

growthF[kk_?NumericQ] := Module[{sol},
  sol = NDSolve[{Dv''[eta] + f1[eta] Dv'[eta] - f2[eta] mu[eta, kk] Dv[eta] == 0,
     Dv[etaini] == Exp[etaini], Dv'[etaini] == Exp[etaini]}, Dv, {eta, etaini, etaev},
    MaxSteps -> Infinity, AccuracyGoal -> 10, PrecisionGoal -> 10];
  {Dv[etaev], Dv'[etaev]} /. sol[[1]]];

{D0v, dD0v} = growthF[0.000001]; f0 = dD0v/D0v;
{Dkv, dDkv} = growthF[k]; fk = dDkv/Dkv;
Print["f0 = ", f0, "   fk = ", fk];

sourceA[kf_, k1_, k2_, eta_] := f2[eta]*(mu[eta, kf] +
    (mu[eta, kf] - mu[eta, k1])*(kf^2 - k1^2 - k2^2)/(2*k2^2) +
    (mu[eta, kf] - mu[eta, k2])*(kf^2 - k1^2 - k2^2)/(2*k1^2));
sourceb[kf_, k1_, k2_, eta_] := f2[eta]*(mu[eta, k1] + mu[eta, k2] - mu[eta, kf]);
D2plusi = 3. Exp[2. etaini]/7.; dD2plusi = 6. Exp[2. etaini]/7.;

(* solveABfull[kf,k1,k2] returns {A,B,Ap,Bp,fp=f(k1),fkm=f(k2)}, for ANY
   momentum ordering (Q/R/N are just different (kf,k1,k2) leg assignments,
   this routine doesn't care which is which). *)
solveABfull[kf_?NumericQ, k1_?NumericQ, k2_?NumericQ] := Module[
  {sol, Dpk1v, dDpk1v, Dpk2v, dDpk2v, Afv, dAfv, Bfv, dBfv, C, Cp},
  sol = NDSolve[{
     Dpk1''[eta] + f1[eta] Dpk1'[eta] - f2[eta] mu[eta, k1] Dpk1[eta] == 0,
     Dpk2''[eta] + f1[eta] Dpk2'[eta] - f2[eta] mu[eta, k2] Dpk2[eta] == 0,
     Af''[eta] + f1[eta] Af'[eta] - f2[eta] mu[eta, kf] Af[eta] == sourceA[kf, k1, k2, eta] Dpk1[eta] Dpk2[eta],
     Bf''[eta] + f1[eta] Bf'[eta] - f2[eta] mu[eta, kf] Bf[eta] == sourceb[kf, k1, k2, eta] Dpk1[eta] Dpk2[eta],
     Dpk1[etaini] == Exp[etaini], Dpk1'[etaini] == Exp[etaini],
     Dpk2[etaini] == Exp[etaini], Dpk2'[etaini] == Exp[etaini],
     Af[etaini] == D2plusi, Af'[etaini] == dD2plusi,
     Bf[etaini] == D2plusi, Bf'[etaini] == dD2plusi},
    {Dpk1, Dpk2, Af, Bf}, {eta, etaini, etaev}, MaxSteps -> Infinity, AccuracyGoal -> 10, PrecisionGoal -> 10];
  Dpk1v = Dpk1[etaev] /. sol[[1]]; dDpk1v = Dpk1'[etaev] /. sol[[1]];
  Dpk2v = Dpk2[etaev] /. sol[[1]]; dDpk2v = Dpk2'[etaev] /. sol[[1]];
  Afv = Af[etaev] /. sol[[1]]; dAfv = Af'[etaev] /. sol[[1]];
  Bfv = Bf[etaev] /. sol[[1]]; dBfv = Bf'[etaev] /. sol[[1]];
  C = (3./7.) Dpk1v Dpk2v; Cp = (3./7.) (dDpk1v Dpk2v + Dpk1v dDpk2v);
  {Afv/C, Bfv/C, dAfv/C - Afv Cp/C^2, dBfv/C - Bfv Cp/C^2, dDpk1v/Dpk1v, dDpk2v/Dpk2v}];

(* ===== Combined Q+R+N loop integral, matching sMGPT's computeOneKBothExact ===== *)
rmax = kmax/k; rmin = kmin/k;

angularSumI1udd1family[q_?NumericQ] := Module[
  {r, muMin, muMax, xNodes, wNodes, total, xv, wv, y, kminus,
   AQ, BQ, ApQ, BpQ, fp, fkm,
   AR, BR, ApR, BpR, dum1, dum2,
   AN, BN, ApN, BpN,
   AngleEvQ, AngleEvR, AngleEvN,
   F2evQ, G2evQ, F2evR, G2evR, F2evN, G2evN,
   tA11, tA12, tA22, tA23, tA33,
   a11, a12, a22, a23, a33,
   A11, A12, A22, A23, A33,
   PSLk, PSLq, PSLkm, y2},
  r = q/k;
  muMin = Max[-1., (1. + r^2 - rmax^2)/(2. r)];
  muMax = If[r >= 0.5, 0.5/r, Min[1., (1. + r^2 - rmin^2)/(2. r)]];
  {xNodes, wNodes} = Transpose[GaussianQuadratureWeights[Nx, muMin, muMax]];
  total = ConstantArray[0., 5];
  PSLk = PSL[k];
  Do[
   xv = xNodes[[i]]; wv = wNodes[[i]];
   y = Sqrt[1. + r^2 - 2. r xv]; y2 = y^2;
   kminus = k y;
   PSLq = PSL[q]; PSLkm = PSL[kminus];

   (* Q ordering: kf=k, k1=q, k2=kminus *)
   {AQ, BQ, ApQ, BpQ, fp, fkm} = solveABfull[k, q, kminus];
   AngleEvQ = (xv - r)/y;
   F2evQ = 0.5 + 3./14. AQ + (0.5 - 3./14. BQ) AngleEvQ^2 + AngleEvQ/2. (y/r + r/y);
   G2evQ = 3./14. AQ (fp + fkm)/f0 + 3./14. ApQ/f0 +
     (0.5 (fp + fkm) - 3./14. BQ (fp + fkm) - 3./14. BpQ) AngleEvQ^2/f0 +
     AngleEvQ/(2. f0) (fkm y/r + fp r/y);

   (* R ordering: kf=kminus, k1=k, k2=q *)
   {AR, BR, ApR, BpR, dum1, dum2} = solveABfull[kminus, k, q];
   AngleEvR = -xv;
   F2evR = 0.5 + 3./14. AR + (0.5 - 3./14. BR) AngleEvR^2 + AngleEvR/2. (1./r + r);
   G2evR = 3./14. AR (fp + fk)/f0 + 3./14. ApR/f0 +
     (0.5 (fp + fk) - 3./14. BR (fp + fk) - 3./14. BpR) AngleEvR^2/f0 +
     AngleEvR/(2. f0) (fk/r + fp r);

   (* N ordering: kf=q, k1=k, k2=kminus *)
   {AN, BN, ApN, BpN, dum1, dum2} = solveABfull[q, k, kminus];
   AngleEvN = -((1. - r xv)/y);
   F2evN = 0.5 + 3./14. AN + (0.5 - 3./14. BN) AngleEvN^2 + AngleEvN/2. (y + 1./y);
   G2evN = 3./14. AN (fk + fkm)/f0 + 3./14. ApN/f0 +
     (0.5 (fk + fkm) - 3./14. BN (fk + fkm) - 3./14. BpN) AngleEvN^2/f0 +
     AngleEvN/(2. f0) (fkm y + fk/y);

   tA11 = 2. F2evQ (xv r fp/f0 + (r^2 (1. - r xv))/y2 fkm/f0);
   tA12 = -(r^2 (1. - xv^2)/y2) F2evQ fp fkm/f0^2;
   tA22 = ((2. r^2 (1. - r xv))/y2 fkm/f0 + 2. xv r fp/f0) G2evQ +
     (r^2 (1. - 3. xv^2) + 2. xv r)/y2 (fkm fp)/f0^2 F2evQ;
   tA23 = (r^2 (xv^2 - 1.))/y2 G2evQ (fkm fp)/f0^2;
   tA33 = (r^2 (1. - 3. xv^2) + 2. xv r)/y2 G2evQ (fkm fp)/f0^2;

   a11 = 2. (F2evR xv r fp/f0 + G2evR (r^2 (1. - r xv))/y2);
   a12 = -(r^2 (1. - xv^2)/y2) G2evR fp/f0;
   a22 = ((r^2 (1. - 3. xv^2) + 2. xv r)/y2 fp/f0 + (2. r^2 (1. - r xv))/y2 fk/f0) G2evR +
     2. xv r (fk fp)/f0^2 F2evR;
   a23 = (r^2 (xv^2 - 1.))/y2 G2evR (fp fk)/f0^2;
   a33 = (r^2 (1. - 3. xv^2) + 2. xv r)/y2 G2evR (fp fk)/f0^2;

   A11 = 2. (G2evN xv r + F2evN (r^2 (1. - r xv))/y2 fkm/f0);
   A12 = -(r^2 (1. - xv^2)/y2) G2evN fkm/f0;
   A22 = ((r^2 (1. - 3. xv^2) + 2. xv r)/y2 fkm/f0 + 2. xv r fk/f0) G2evN +
     (2. r^2 (1. - r xv))/y2 (fkm fk)/f0^2 F2evN;
   A23 = (r^2 (xv^2 - 1.))/y2 (fkm fk)/f0^2 G2evN;
   A33 = (r^2 (1. - 3. xv^2) + 2. xv r)/y2 (fkm fk)/f0^2 G2evN;

   total += wv * {
      A11 PSLk PSLkm + tA11 PSLq PSLkm + a11 PSLk PSLq,
      A12 PSLk PSLkm + tA12 PSLq PSLkm + a12 PSLk PSLq,
      A22 PSLk PSLkm + tA22 PSLq PSLkm + a22 PSLk PSLq,
      A23 PSLk PSLkm + tA23 PSLq PSLkm + a23 PSLk PSLq,
      A33 PSLk PSLkm + tA33 PSLq PSLkm + a33 PSLk PSLq
      };
   , {i, 1, Nx}];
  q^2 total
  ];

qGrid = Table[10.^lq, {lq, Log10[kmin], Log10[kmax], (Log10[kmax] - Log10[kmin])/(Nq - 1)}];
trapzQ[vals_List] := Sum[(vals[[i]] + vals[[i - 1]])/2. (qGrid[[i]] - qGrid[[i - 1]]), {i, 2, Length[qGrid]}];

Print["Computing I1udd1-family loop (", Nq*Nx, " points, 3 ODE solves each)..."];
valsFamily = angularSumI1udd1family /@ qGrid;
{I1udd1A, I2uud1A, I2uud2A, I3uuu2A, I3uuu3A} = (1./(2. Pi^2)) trapzQ[valsFamily];
Print[""]; Print["=== I1udd1-family (Q+R+N combined) at k=", k, " ==="];
Print["I1udd1A=", I1udd1A, "  I2uud1A=", I2uud1A, "  I2uud2A=", I2uud2A,
      "  I3uuu2A=", I3uuu2A, "  I3uuu3A=", I3uuu3A];
